acs_url_help: Register this in your IdP as the reply URL or Assertion Consumer Service.
attribute_email_help: The value of this attribute is used as the email address. One name per line, tried in order.
attribute_groups_help: Group membership. Recorded only; not used for permissions yet.
attributes_description: The attribute names your IdP sends. Leave blank to try the common defaults in order.
certificate_help: The IdP's signing certificate. It is a public key, so it is not a secret. You can paste PEM as is.
description: Let people sign in with your organisation's IdP, such as Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace or Okta.
enable_help: Entity ID, SSO URL and certificate are all required before you can turn this on.
error_forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
error_incomplete: Entity ID, SSO URL and certificate are all required to turn on SSO.
error_invalid_certificate: The certificate could not be read. Provide X.509 in PEM or base64.
error_invalid_metadata: Entity ID, SSO URL and certificate could not be read from the metadata.
error_invalid_url: That is not a valid URL.
idp_entity_id_help: The IdP's identifier. It appears as entityID in the IdP metadata.
idp_sso_url_help: The IdP URL that starts the sign-in.
metadata_help: Paste the metadata XML your IdP publishes and the entity ID, SSO URL and certificate are read from it.
password_still_works: Turning on SSO keeps password sign-in available, so a mistake in the IdP settings cannot lock you out.
sp_description: Register these values in your IdP's admin console.
sp_entity_id_help: Your IdP may call this the identifier or audience.
sp_heading: Values to register in your IdP
title: SSO (SAML)
